summary: Implementation fully matches the saved plan for #479. effective_merge_strategies() now returns BitBucket Cloud's default allowed set (merge_commit, squash, fast_forward) via the new module-level _BB_CLOUD_DEFAULT_MERGE_STRATEGIES constant when neither merge_strategies nor default_merge_strategy is present, returning a fresh list (not None); the explicit-restriction and default-only early returns are unchanged and the docstring was refreshed. All planned TDD tests exist: forge-level cases a (defaults_to_bb_cloud), b (honors_explicit_restriction), b' (explicit_wins_over_default), c (default_only), and d (default_set_maps_to_neutral_methods); plus the client-level regression test_fetch_repo_merge_methods_defaults_to_bb_cloud_set_when_unconstrained and the deliberately updated test_fetch_branch_merge_methods_absent_defaults_to_bb_cloud_set (was *_returns_none). GitHub paths are untouched. The change is scoped to the BitBucket parsing module plus a minor, behavior-preserving cleanup in bitbucket_client.py that drops the now-dead 'strategies is None' guard in the branch-merge-methods consumer — directly caused by and consistent with the plan's documented cascade, not a new behavior.
